scope: Document and verify the ownership boundary for staged DXF write inspector closures and their callback views.

contract.callbackClosure: Inspector setters retain an owned copy of the callback and its value captures in dxfRW.
contract.referenceCaptures: Objects reached through reference captures remain the caller's lifetime responsibility and must outlive every possible invocation.
contract.view: DxfObjectsWriteView byte and code-page views expire when the callback returns; callbacks must not retain them.

implementation.control: A weak_ptr observes that a value-captured object remains alive after the caller releases its copy, remains alive through one inspector invocation, and is released after clearing the inspector.

limitations: This control covers inspector closure ownership and the documented callback-view lifetime; it does not audit every public API or internal borrowed pointer.
Reference captures still depend on caller-managed object lifetime.
No platform numeric/string policy, DWG/DXF semantic support, concurrency, or consumer qualification claim is made.
next: Audit remaining source-lifetime boundaries and platform numeric/string policies; keep each issue tied to a concrete public/internal lifetime path or platform-specific failure.
